title: Categories with enough injectives
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. The category $\mathcal C$ has enough injectives if every object X admits a monomorphism X \hookrightarrow I into an injective object I, where injective means that every morphism M \to I extends across every monomorphism M \hookrightarrow N.
